**[P2] Bind all exact-evidence foreign procedures before counting support complete**

Three `F` decisions fall through the generic `None` default even though their exact QP/MS evidence directly matches models already present in this dictionary: `qrow_9709_m25_qp_32_q07::q07/a` (QP p10 / MS p15: product-rule differentiation, set the derivative to zero for a maximum) and `qrow_9709_s25_qp_33_q11::q11/a` (QP p16 / MS p23: the same stationary-point procedure) both match `STATIONARY_MODEL`; `qrow_9709_s25_qp_31_q09::q09/a` (QP p14 / MS p17: integrate `6x ln x` by parts to derive the root equation) matches `INTEGRATION_BY_PARTS_MODEL`. Because `build_decisions_and_delta` creates a supporting instance only when `procedure_model_ref` is non-null, all three are currently absent from the candidate composition/KG/product preview even though #1730 explicitly requires capture of cross-family supporting applications. Add these mappings, regenerate the cumulative artifacts/counts/hashes, and extend the focused test to assert the three exact part/model pairs; the current `23` supporting and `132` total instance counts are consequently undercounts.
